nodes.description: Public string state variable 'name' holding the token name, set to 'FLY DOGE' in the constructor.
Public string state variable 'symbol' holding the token symbol, set to 'FDOGE' in the constructor.
Public uint8 state variable 'decimals' fixed to 18 in the constructor.
Public uint256 '_totalSupply' set to 1000000000000000000000000000000000 in the constructor and read by totalSupply().
Internal mapping(address => uint) 'balances' tracking token ownership; written by the constructor, transfer and transferFrom, read by balanceOf and totalSupply.
Internal nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) 'allowed' tracking ERC20 allowances; written by approve and transferFrom, read by allowance.
msg.sender: attacker-controlled caller address used as balance owner, allowance owner and spender throughout the token contracts.
constructor() public: initialises name, symbol, decimals and _totalSupply and credits the whole supply to msg.sender.
totalSupply() public view returns (uint): returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)], an unchecked subtraction.
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) public view returns (uint balance): reads the balances mapping for the supplied owner.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) public view returns (uint remaining): reads the nested allowed mapping.
approve(address spender, uint tokens) public returns (bool): overwrites allowed[msg.sender][spender] with the supplied amount and emits Approval.
transfer(address to, uint tokens) public returns (bool): moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) public returns (bool): moves tokens from 'from' using the caller's allowance and emits Transfer.
safeAdd(uint a, uint b) public pure returns (uint c): c = a + b with an overflow require check.
safeSub(uint a, uint b) public pure returns (uint c): requires b <= a then c = a - b.
safeMul(uint a, uint b) public pure returns (uint c): c = a * b with a division-based overflow check.
safeDiv(uint a, uint b) public pure returns (uint c): requires b > 0 then c = a / b.
Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] inside totalSupply() that can underflow and wrap the reported supply.
transferFrom debits balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender] based purely on caller-supplied parameters with no explicit allowance sufficiency check before moving value.
approve lets the caller overwrite an arbitrary existing allowance without setting it to zero first, enabling the classic allowance front-running race.
Parameter 'spender' of approve(address spender, uint tokens).
Parameter 'tokens' of approve(address spender, uint tokens).
Parameter 'to' of transfer(address to, uint tokens).
Parameter 'tokens' of transfer(address to, uint tokens).

Parameter 'to' of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens).
Parameter 'tokens' of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens).

Parameter 'tokenOwner' of allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender).
Parameter 'spender' of allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender).

Parameter 'b' of safeAdd(uint a, uint b).
Parameter 'a' of safeSub(uint a, uint b).
Parameter 'b' of safeSub(uint a, uint b).
Parameter 'a' of safeMul(uint a, uint b).
Parameter 'b' of safeMul(uint a, uint b).
Parameter 'a' of safeDiv(uint a, uint b).
Parameter 'b' of safeDiv(uint a, uint b).
Local/return variable 'c' of safeAdd holding a + b.
Local/return variable 'c' of safeSub holding a - b.
Local/return variable 'c' of safeMul holding a * b.
Local/return variable 'c' of safeDiv holding a / b.
Return variable 'balance' of balanceOf carrying balances[tokenOwner].
Return variable 'remaining' of allowance carrying allowed[tokenOwner][spender].

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the balance owner key in the constructor, transfer and transferFrom.
allowed[msg.sender][spender] is written in approve and spent in transferFrom, so caller identity governs allowances.
constructor credits the entire initial supply to msg.sender.
approve uses msg.sender as the owner of the allowance being set.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is consumed.
msg.sender is the spender identity driving the unchecked allowance debit in transferFrom.
the unchecked subtraction is executed inside totalSupply.
_totalSupply is the minuend of the subtraction that can underflow.
balances[address(0)] is the subtrahend of the subtraction that can underflow.
allowance reads the nested allowed mapping.
approve writes into the allowed mapping.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom writes into the allowed mapping.
transferFrom calls safeSub for the balance and allowance debits.
the unchecked allowance handling is executed inside transferFrom.
allowed[from][msg.sender] is decremented without an explicit sufficiency check before value moves.
the 'from' parameter keys the allowance mapping that is debited.
the 'tokens' parameter is subtracted from the caller's allowance.
the unsafe allowance overwrite is executed inside approve.
the 'spender' parameter identifies the allowance being overwritten.
tokens value is stored into allowed[msg.sender][spender].
local result c is assigned the sum a + b inside safeAdd.
local result c is assigned the difference a - b inside safeSub.
local result c is assigned the product a * b inside safeMul.
local result c is assigned the quotient a / b inside safeDiv.
return variable balance carries balances[tokenOwner] out of balanceOf.
return variable remaining carries allowed[tokenOwner][spender] out of allowance.

normalization_plan.reason: The 'spender' parameter only exists to key the allowed mapping written by approve; it collapses into the approve function node.
The 'tokens' parameter only exists to be stored into allowed[msg.sender][spender] by approve, so it merges into approve.
The 'to' parameter is a purely internal recipient argument of transfer and has no independent semantic identity.
The 'tokens' parameter is only consumed by the safeSub/safeAdd calls inside transfer.
The 'from' parameter only serves to index balances and allowed inside transferFrom.
The 'to' parameter is only the credit address used by transferFrom.
The 'tokens' parameter is the amount debited and credited inside transferFrom.
The 'tokenOwner' parameter only indexes the balances mapping read by balanceOf.
The 'tokenOwner' parameter only indexes the outer allowed mapping read by allowance.
The 'spender' parameter only indexes the inner allowed mapping read by allowance.
The 'a' operand is an implementation detail of the safeAdd helper.
The 'b' operand is an implementation detail of the safeAdd helper.
The 'a' operand is an implementation detail of the safeSub helper.
The 'b' operand is an implementation detail of the safeSub helper.
The 'a' operand is an implementation detail of the safeMul helper.
The 'b' operand is an implementation detail of the safeMul helper.
The 'a' operand is an implementation detail of the safeDiv helper.
The 'b' operand is an implementation detail of the safeDiv helper.
The temporary result variable c exists only inside safeAdd.
The temporary result variable c exists only inside safeSub.

The temporary result variable c exists only inside safeDiv.
The return variable balance is just the value returned by balanceOf.
The return variable remaining is just the value returned by allowance.
